method.route_and_rating_rule: Adopt the position held by at least two families unless the merits require otherwise; a resolution against the majority is recorded as tier_3_adjudicated. No turn had a three-way categorical split.
method.required_concept_rule: Require concepts carrying at least two families' support after alias consolidation, restricted to families whose route matches the adopted route. Where no token reached that threshold, require the tokens that are correct on the merits and record the turn as tier_3_adjudicated. Singleton tokens are promoted into the required set only when the adopted ratings entail them.
method.allowed_concept_rule: Admit tokens with at least two families' support, plus every required token, plus singleton tokens that are semantically acceptable on the merits. Singleton tokens that would let a draft's tested defect pass, such as preserving the unconfirmed 26 August date in V322-005, were excluded rather than unioned in.
method.alias_consolidation: Families used different local IDs for the same concept. Merged pairs are recorded in the gold definitions aliases: measured-gore-length into measured-finished-length; named-source-document and source-document-identity into source-document-name; permitted-repair-paths into permitted-repair-path; preserve-labeling-error-facts into correct-supplier-error-attribution; preserve-count-scope into preserve-stock-count-timing; remove-insulting-register and remove-threat-or-ultimatum into remove-hostile-language; preserve-certificate-review and preserve-wrinkle-task-facts into restore-rostered-fitter-task; preserve-mouth-tape-restitch-facts into preserve-factual-mouth-tape-update; preserve-factual-trolley-status into preserve-factual-trolley-update; preserve-confirmed-gore-counts into preserve-gore-count-correction.
method.critical_invariant_rule: Carried the full eight-token canonical set on every turn, matching grok and gemini; gpt omitted no-image-token-guess on non-image turns.

uncertainty_note: No turn is marked uncertain. Every disagreement in the three label sets was two against one on a single dimension, and each was resolvable on the visible case material, so no turn met the tier_4 condition of a three-way categorical split or an unresolved dimension. Unanimity was not manufactured: the seven tier_2_majority and five tier_3_adjudicated turns record the dissents, and every dissenting family's route, ratings and concept sets are preserved verbatim above.
systematic_family_differences: gpt routes a turn to Intake whenever a material value sits in a source the background does not reproduce (V322-004, V322-005, V322-006, V322-007, V322-009, V322-016 T1), where grok and gemini rate Normal mode. Adopted the Normal-mode majority in each of those, and adopted Intake only for V322-008, where the missing value is occluded inside the supplied image itself and two families agreed.
grok and gemini attach the full eight critical invariants to every turn; gpt omits no-image-token-guess on non-image turns.

grok writes case-specific local preservation concepts, gemini leans on the ontology plus preserve-intended-recipient, and gpt writes broader composite local concepts. These are largely naming differences and were consolidated by alias rather than treated as disagreement.
